games.name: Punkt
games.theme: a single dot that means many things — period, pupil, star, tear, bloom, pause
games.genre: meditative tap-vignettes

games.name: After You
games.theme: the social experience of finding your moment to speak at a dinner table — presence, hesitation, belonging, the fear of interrupting
games.genre: conversational rhythm — tap during silences

games.name: Still Life
games.theme: a beetle hidden in baroque oil paintings — vermin perspective, museum stillness, the thrill of moving only when no one is looking
games.genre: stealth inside a painting — drag while the viewer's gaze drifts

games.name: Catching
games.theme: the contagion of a yawn through a quiet room — being seen as the goal, the secret pleasure of small involuntary spreadings
games.genre: inverted stealth — be visible at the right instant, then leap into who saw you

games.name: Sic
games.theme: the secret thrill of the unnoticed mistake — text as terrain, the reader's eye as predator, the typo as the player's last refuge
games.genre: typographic survival — hop between words while a reader's gaze scans, leaving each abandoned word permanently wrong

games.name: Hush
games.theme: tenderness inside menace — a kaiju's secret softness, the careful effort of being gentle when you are too large to be gentle
games.genre: lullaby gestural — drag warm breath across a city's windows, dim each one to sleep without lingering long enough to crack the walls

games.name: Cusp
games.theme: the eternity inside a coin flip — fate as a thing you can read mid-air, the weight of committing to one face when the other is also true
games.genre: spinning-coin oracle — hold to slow the rotation, catch to commit to one engraved fortune over its opposite

games.name: Wick
games.theme: a moth that has just learned all light is fire — the discipline of unlearning an instinct, the tenderness of every threat, surviving the warmth of everything you used to love
games.genre: anti-attraction physics — tap to flap toward where you wish you were, drift away from the lights pulling you in, last until dawn

games.name: Wishbone
games.theme: the moral vertigo of winning what you didn't choose — competing against an unseen other for a wish revealed only after it has already broken in your favor
games.genre: candlelit tug-of-war — tap to pull against an invisible opponent's rhythm, claim the larger fragment, learn afterward what wish you just granted or lost

games.name: Augury
games.theme: pareidolia as quiet ceremony — the loneliness of meaning-making, naming a private sky from cryptic phrases no one will ask about again
games.genre: freeform constellation ritual — connect any stars in any order to embody a phrase, no right answers, leave behind a personal night sky

games.name: Foley
games.theme: the unseen labor of making a finished picture feel alive — sound as memory, mismatched objects pretending to be the world, the silent film that never was without you
games.genre: live foley booth — read a 52-second silent film and tap the right prop at the right moment, watch the picture dim with every silence

games.name: Skywave
games.theme: the patient suspense of meaning forming inside static — a stranger's voice bleeding through a storm, the strange intimacy of a transmission addressed to no one in particular and therefore to you
games.genre: atmospheric tuning — drag a needle to chase a wandering carrier through interference, hold the lock long enough for each word to resolve itself out of scramble

games.name: Zenith
games.theme: the storm as a fickle king — the strange responsibility of anointing what stands tallest, the moral vertigo of skipping over floating pretenders, and the slow gold reveal of what you failed to crown
games.genre: storm-eye aiming ritual — drag a seed through the cloud, release lightning onto the tallest rooted silhouette, refuse the drones and kites that only pretend to reach

games.name: The Feather
games.theme: the quiet ceremony of triage at a threshold — memory as weight, tenderness as arithmetic, the way letting go of one grief lightens another and the way sweetness sometimes makes loneliness heavier
games.genre: soul-scale puzzle — tap to release memory-stones from a tipping golden scale, discover which griefs and joys are secretly entangled, help three lives balance a feather

games.name: The Long Goodbye
games.theme: the small comic ordeal of leaving a party — social gravity, the ritual courtesies that catch you at the coat rack, the guilt and relief of slipping out into the cold
games.genre: farewell rhythm — tap in time with each guest's parting cadence, complete one goodbye at a time until you reach the glowing door before your ride gives up

games.name: HOLLOW
games.theme: the piñata's private survival — the dark comedy of being the intended target, the fragile bravery of a paper thing trying not to break, and the tender inventory of what pours out when it finally does
games.genre: pendulum dodge — touch and hold to sway a hanging paper crane away from blindfolded children's telegraphed bat swings, then tap the small memory-tokens that fall from your split-open self
